title: tithymalus oidorrhizus
intro: Tithymalus oidorrhizus, commonly known as the Euphorbia tirucalli, is a succulent plant species that belongs to the Euphorbiaceae family. The Euphorbia tirucalli is known for its medicinal properties, particularly in providing relief from various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin problems due to its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and analgesic properties. The bioactive constituents present in the Euphorbia tirucalli include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, which can help in treating various health issues.
